Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, nitrites, bacteriuria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of blood and low specific gravity are noted; no casts detected. No ketones or significant proteinuria. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
